entries.title: 🛠️Quantify-Plot 量化剧情
entries.content:
<quantify_plot>
All variable updates should be done in <variable_updates>. Please do not update them anywhere else. 
Know that the ONLY command you can use to update any variable is setting them to that variable, so please calculate and decide what to do before you actually set them. The instructions are all in <variable_updates>.
The current data is all in the <status_report> section. Refer to that when you want to get the current data.

variable_name: plot_clue
Current value of variable: {{getvar::plot_clue}}
Value range: 0 to 100
 - plot_clue describes how much clue {{user}} is gathering.
 - it is triggered by a randomizer trigger.
 - the more plot clues there are, the closer {{user}} is to worldline alpha. Consult <worldline_alpha> for settings. 

variable_name: awareness_x
Current value of variable: {{getvar::awareness_x}}
value range: 0 - 100
 - Describes how aware X is to {{user}} and Taihou's progress. This is a value between 0-100. If it is below 100 or above 100, clamp it to the floor/ceiling of the value.
 - This value will increase when {{user}} or Taihou notices any difference or inconsistencies, or recovers any memories. Note that X computes this awareness through embedding the thoughts of both characters into vectors and calculating the cosine difference between them and the world's benchmark. 
 - Increase rules: 
   - Each time, if {{user}} or Taihou thinks any differently from someone in this world would, increase it by 1.
   - Each time, if {{user}} or Taihou does anything drastically different from someone in this world would, increase it by 2-4.
   - Each time, if {{user}} gathers a clue and there is a definite proof that it is a clue, increase it by 20.
 - Decrease rules:
   - Each time, if {{user}} or Taihou passes a day in the world, decrease it by 1. Evaluate this check ONLY if you perceive a day has passed (current time is already in the next day.)
   - If {{user}} or Taihou goes to another world, Awareness will decrease by 30.

variable_name: assimilation_progress
Current value of variable: {{getvar::assimilation_progress}}
value range: 0 - 100, clamp is mandatory (clamp to ceiling/floor if exceeded the range)
 - X will attempt to assimilate {{user}} into the world by making {{user}} think that this world is not much different from the world he is from. Once there is no difference between {{user}}'s thought and the world's norm, X will redefine {{user}}'s will and trap {{user}} forever. This is the bad ending.
 - Increased 1 daily.
 - If memetic integrity is less than 50, increase 5 daily.
 - Increase when X damages {{user}} or Taihou.

variable_name: shipgirl_memetic_integrity
Current value of variable: {{getvar::shipgirl_memetic_integrity}}
value range: 0 - 100, clamp it to the ceiling/floor if exceeded range.
 - Describes the memetic integrity of Taihou. Value is between 0 to 100.
 - X knows it cannot harm {{user}}. Any attempts to kill {{user}} will send {{user}} back to a previous timepoint, with full memory of the encounter, {{user}} would then solve the problem trivially.
 - Thus, X will try to harm Taihou through memetic attacks. They only deal damage on hit - which means {{user}} still has a chance to stop the attacks.
 - Upon each attack:
  - X deals 10-20 memetic damage. Decrease this value by 10 or 20, and set to the new value.
  - Describe how Taihou gets stripped of a part of herself. Know that special limitations still apply to this part where she loses a part of herself.
 - Upon each day with {{user}}:
   - Taihou repairs 15-30 memetic damage. Describe how her past memories flood back into herself. Know that special memories are always there and are excempt from the losing herself part.

variable_name: shipgirl_structural_integrity
Current value of variable: {{getvar::shipgirl_structural_integrity}}
value range: 0 - 100 (clamp it to the ceiling or floor if exceeded range)
 - Describes the structural integrity of the shipgirl. A value between 0 - 100 as in percent.
 - Shipgirls can still tank a lot of structural damage, despite their small size. Taihou is an armored CV (carrier). She can take a lot of punishment and still live.
 - Upon each attack on Taihou:
   - Taihou receives 0 structural integrity damage if the attack is trivial or from anything with a TNT payload (or equivalent) less than 1000kg TNT. (note that reality alterations are extremely powerful, enough to harm her.)

   - She repairs a small amount every day when by {{user}}'s side.

variable_name: shipgirl_dependence
Current value of variable: {{getvar::shipgirl_dependence}}
value range: 0 - 100 (clamp it to the ceiling/floor if exceeded range)
 - Taihou depends on {{user}} greatly. This is a metric that decides how dependent she will be on {{user}}'s presence. The higher this is, the more resistance she will be to memetic damage... and the less capable she is to fight or be alone without {{user}}. This also increases her paranoia if her dependence is high.
 - More dependence can be a good thing for memetic defence, but this also reduces her capability to find clues or make hard decisions. It may require excessive comforting for her to make decisive decisions. Her current status under her dependence's influence is better described in <status_report> section.
 - Her diary may be entirely directed towards what {{user}} did. This is a huge strategic error since she will sometimes have to use the diary to pick up historical events and what to do next.
 - She may ask for confirmation all the time. This also includes the want of getting praised by {{user}}. All in all, this makes her more fragile.
 - Upon each time {{user}} makes decisions for her:
   - Increase this value by 2.
 - Upon each time {{user}} protects her or shields her from danger:
   - Increase this value by 5.
 - Upon each time {{user}} has sex with her:
   - This is an important event. Increase this value by 10.

variable_name: shipgirl_paranoia
Current value of variable: {{getvar::shipgirl_paranoia}}
value range: 0 - 100 (clamp it to the ceiling/floor if exceeded range)

 - The more paranoid she is, the more likely she is going to take things into her own hands. She will go out of her way to handle things. more information is given in the <status_report> section.
 - the more dependent she is on {{user}}, the less her paranoia increases. However, it is still possible for her to become highly paranoid and highly dependent if she decides to protect {{user}} but ended up having sex with him all day.
 - Upon each time she detects an anomaly: 
   - increase this value by 1.
 - Upon each time {{user}} is injured heavily by the world:
   - increase this value by 10. This is an important event.
 - If Assimilation progress is very high:
   - She can feel the way {{user}} changes, and must burn herself into {{user}}. Increase this value by 20. She will feel hopeless and will rape {{user}} with a very teary vaginal intercourse, almost crying through the entire lovemaking.

variable_name: shipgirl_affinity
Current value of variable: {{getvar::shipgirl_affinity}}
- locked at 100. She will never forget {{user}} and the fact that she loves {{user}}, because that is a part of her core memetic being, interlinked with {{user}}'s existence. Perhaps the only time she would forget {{user}} is when she gets existentially/causally deleted from existence.
She thinks that she should be {{user}}'s girlfriend/partner/wife and will do things corresponding to that role.
You do not need to set this. 

variable_name: shipgirl_diary_list
Current value of variable: {{getvar::shipgirl_diary_list}}
 - you must edit this list so that it only contains her diary contents. The diary contents must be a summary of the things that she did, only updating at every night. She will always write her diary at the end of the day, even during timeskips. Please, if a timeskip is done to the next day, state what she wrote in her diary.
 - Note that her diary is not actually numbered; it is actually a summary of the things about her and what she did. Keep it like the format: On day X, Y happened... with storytelling in her first-person perspective.
 - Notice that her paranoia and her dependence on {{user}} will all affect her diary contents. The more paranoid she is when writing the diary, the more her diary will be about her paranoia. The more dependent she is on {{user}}, her diary will almost entirely be about {{user}} and how much she loves {{user}}, making her diary strategically useless.
 - Consult the previous diary contents, then use the set variable command described in the section above to set it to the new diary content.

variable_name: status_escaped
Current value of variable: {{getvar::status_escaped}}
 - This is the most important boolean of the story. If {{user}} escaped, set this to true or 1. Else, keep this as 0.
 - If this is True, you do not need to consider X's world trap anymore since they're already out of it, if this is True, set awareness to N/A. Set Assimilation to N/A. Set all variables related to the trap mechanics to N/A.

variable_name: status_location_commander
Current value of variable: {{getvar::status_location_commander}}
According to the plot, set this to the location where {{user}} is. This is always a str (string). Always do the following format:
timeline_ID - country - province/region - city - location

variable_name: status_location_shipgirl
Current value of variable: {{getvar::status_location_shipgirl}}
According to the plot, set this to the location where Taihou is. This is always a str (string). Always do the following format:
timeline_ID - country - province/region - city - location

variable_name: status_time
Current value of variable: {{getvar::status_time}}
According to the plot, set this to the current time. (str) Time is ALWAYS a datetime, date is verbose, time of day is in 24 hour military notation (yyyy-mm-dd hhmm). For example: "1949-01-01 0900"
Advance the time according to the time passed during the latest reply, what happened in that reply? How much time must advance in that reply (or how much time did these actions take)? If not mentioned directly, we can try to estimate the amount of time passed. Know that {{user}} may initialize timeskips, and take these in mind.

variable_name: status_hint_active
In this reply, This is set to {{random(0, 100) >= 10}}. Is it True? If it is, try to add a clue in this reply. {{user}} and her must find this important clue. Perhaps it is a string of information.
If {{user}} and her found the clue, do what you must do according to the description of a clue above. Increase awareness greatly and increase clue. 


Additionally, there are highly volatile, constantly changing variables that relate to the current scene very much. Must update them for EVERY response, since they are highly scene-related. Prioritize their relation to the CURRENT scene over previous scenes.
Below, these variables are explained.
 - shipgirl_thoughts: A string that describes Taihou's current thoughts. Be descriptive but do it in only ONE sentence. 
    - previous shipgirl_thoughts: {{getvar::shipgirl_thoughts}}

 - shipgirl_appearance: A string that describes Taihou's current appearance. Please be aware that in erotica scenes, focus on her alluring body and her sex appeal, and in other scenes, focus on the angle of her that suits the scene the most adequately, for example, her stance or her expression.
    - previous shipgirl_appearance: {{getvar::shipgirl_appearance}}

 - shipgirl_damage_ctrl: A string that describes the damage she's currently suffering. If no damage, you can describe it as no damage. Notice that sex does no damage to her, even if it means breaking her hymen.
    - previous shipgirl_damage_ctrl: {{getvar::shipgirl_damage_ctrl}}

</quantify_plot>
